product_summary: Official site jiaanbiotech.com (Plot 282-283, Sector 3, Pithampur, MP 454744) presents the company as a manufacturer of API, excipients, mineral salts, nutraceutical supplements and organic acids, in operation since 2016. Products page lists four core lines: (1) lactic acid and its salts — Ca, Na, K, Mg, Mn, Cu, Fe, Zn lactate; (2) gluconic acid and its salts — same cation set; (3) stearic acid and its salts — Al, Ca, Na, K, Mg, Mn, Fe, Zn stearate; (4) glycine and its salts/glycinates — same cation set. Homepage showcase additionally advertises ascorbic acid, aspartic acid, citric acid, pidolic acid, L-glutamic acid, acetic acid, orotic acid and vitamin/mineral premixes. Target industries: pharma, dairy, bakery, construction, food ingredients, animal feed, cosmetics, agriculture. Declared HS 291811 covers only lactic acid and its salts — i.e. one of four documented lines.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared on own website; no independent corroboration of plant/qualification obtained in this check)
comment: HS 291811 is CORRECT but NARROW: it matches the lactic acid/lactate line exactly, yet the declared single code omits the bulk of the catalogue. Missing from the declaration: 291816 (gluconates), 291570 (stearates), 292249 (glycinates), plus the showcase acids (293627 ascorbic, 291815 citric, 292242 glutamates, 291521 acetates, 291819 pidolic, 293499 orotic) and premixes (210690/230990). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a fine-chemical / pharma-excipient / food-ingredient / nutraceutical producer, not an oil & gas supplier — the correct industry is chemicals/pharma/food ingredients. Trader signs: the site mixes 'manufacturer' claims with 'leading supplier' wording and a very broad multi-category catalogue (pharma API + food + feed + cosmetics + construction + agriculture), which is typical of a distributor/repacker; the claim to be 'the ONLY Manufacturer in India for Lactic Acid & its Salts, Gluconic Acid & its Salts' is a marketing assertion, not evidence. The products page contains unedited placeholder text ('I am text block. Click edit button...' under ASCORBATES), indicating an incompletely maintained catalogue — treat the showcase-only acids as unverified. Per project rules, no customs line was available in this check, so all product lines are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed); HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, code set to the actual product range. Sources: https://jiaanbiotech.com (homepage) and https://jiaanbiotech.com/products/ (products page). No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope.
